scope: Approval only to prepare a bounded local implementation/test packet for the fixed atomic loan and swap milestone. No implementation, wallet creation, transaction, public financial test, native-history, private-handoff, full-language or release acceptance. Frozen bundle: base=head=1a9721e5634e9196aadbe7c28a51081e820a9247; diff SHA256=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855.
rationale: No material defect found for this preparation-only decision. The custody-contract (sha256:5fe9cf1e8531c0599ffb6286d2d3e1558464792038311208aa7db2807f026038, lines 5-19) requires constrained circuit-checked capabilities, trusted sealed enrollment, recoverable custody, one-shot initialization, action/revision binding, complete financial accounting, rejection controls and separate later admissions. Source-extracts (sha256:f0bbbbe358831cc836fcf515b0ff06c4cffee81caf22a2dfe9d26e7f70ab3e83: unshielded-token.md lines 170-230; compact-reference.md lines 1038-1080 and 1305-1355; standard-library.compact lines 312-342) support hash-based possession checks, distrust of witnesses, sealed initialization, receipt/payer separation and entry-balance semantics. Exact encodings, numeric financial comparisons, payer-verifier adequacy and test results remain obligations of the later packet, not established results. The proposal preserves these limits and does not infer wallet-signature compatibility from a helper name. All required artifact digests and lengths matched; before/after hashes are unchanged and recorded in native-gpt6-review-notes.md. Native terminal completion must be observed by the parent transport.
